skills.name: Code Review
skills.trigger: Review the current diff, PR, branch, or path target for correctness bugs and reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups.
procedure: Scope the target: current diff, or a given PR number/branch/path.
Run at the requested effort level.
Check logic, style, security, and test coverage.
Support --comment and --fix flags.
Report findings most-severe first.
skills.output: Risk-ranked findings list; optionally inline PR comments or applied fixes.
token_policy: Reuse the canonical SKILLS_CATALOG.yaml entry instead of restating it.
Keep this card to trigger + procedure + delta from the previous snapshot.
compatibility: /review is a legacy alias since v2.1.227 - not a separate skill.
Runs as a background subagent since v2.1.218.
Do not overwrite existing dated skill snapshots.
skills.summary: Renamed from /review (kept as alias) in v2.1.227; runs as a background subagent since v2.1.218; no longer auto-runs on every turn since v2.1.215.

skills.name: Claude API
skills.trigger: Code imports the anthropic SDK, or user asks about Claude API/Anthropic SDK features.
procedure: Check target SDK (Python or TypeScript/JS).
Use `upgrade` subcommand for Python 0.x to 1.x migration.
Use `prompt-audit` subcommand for prompt/tool auditing.
Reference current model ids and pricing, not memorized defaults.
skills.output: Working Claude API integration code, or a migration/audit report.
token_policy: Reuse the canonical SKILLS_CATALOG.yaml models table instead of restating it.
Link to source doc sections instead of copying long API reference text.
compatibility: Reference model ids from SKILLS_CATALOG.yaml `models:` block.
Do not overwrite existing dated skill snapshots.
skills.summary: upgrade subcommand (Python SDK 0.x to 1.x) added v2.1.239; prompt-audit subcommand added v2.1.221; default reference model bumped to Claude Opus 5 as of v2.1.219.

skills.name: Simplify
skills.trigger: User asks to clean up, simplify, or refactor changed code (quality only).
procedure: Review changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, altitude.
Prefer smallest working change; no premature abstractions.
Apply the fixes directly.
skills.output: Cleaned-up diff with no behavior change and no new bugs.
token_policy: Reuse the canonical SKILLS_CATALOG.yaml entry instead of duplicating it.
compatibility: Complements /code-review (bug-hunting); simplify does not hunt bugs.
Do not overwrite existing dated skill snapshots.
skills.summary: No changelog-visible behavior change between v2.1.129 and v2.1.241.

Rank findings by risk.
